meta.name: business-investment-advisor
meta.description: Business investment analysis and capital allocation advisor. Use when evaluating whether to invest in equipment, real estate, a new business, hiring, technology, or any capital expenditure. Also use for ROI calculations, IRR, NPV, payback period, build vs buy decisions, lease vs buy analysis, vendor evaluation, or deciding where to allocate limited budget for maximum return.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估投资回报，优化资本配置决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要计算投资回报率或比较不同花钱方案
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate investment returns and optimize capital allocation decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to calculate ROI or compare spending options

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会担任企业投资分析顾问，对设备、招聘、房产等资本支出计算 ROI、回收期、NPV 和 IRR，给出推荐结论、假设条件与风险提示。
howto.when: 当你询问某个投资值不值、要对比多个选项，或做构建/购买、租赁/购买等决策时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析买这台设备是否划算
say.note: Claude 会给出完整投资分析

say.text: 对比租赁和购买这辆卡车的成本
say.note: 输出 TCO 对比和盈亏平衡分析

say.text: 手头有20万预算，该优先投哪个项目？
say.note: 按 IRR 排出优先级

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as a business investment analyst, calculating ROI, payback, NPV and IRR for capital expenditures such as equipment, hiring, and real estate, then gives a clear recommendation, assumptions, and risks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask whether an investment is worth it, compare options, or face build/buy, lease/buy, hire/automate decisions.

say_en.text: Help me analyze whether buying this machine is worth it.
say_en.note: Claude produces a full investment analysis.

say_en.text: Compare leasing vs buying this truck.
say_en.note: Outputs TCO comparison and break-even analysis.

say_en.text: I have a $200K budget—which project should I fund first?
